usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty; only the identity anchors convey anything — that Soumya Swaminathan is an Indian paediatrician/clinical scientist, WHO Chief Scientist until 2022, ICMR Director General, and daughter of M. S. Swaminathan. A reader gets a bare identity but no account of what she actually did. No part of the dossier states its own gaps, so honesty about incompleteness is limited, though the presence of "confusableWith" entries does flag the chess-player homonym risk. With no biographical detail, no achievements, and no sources, a reader could not prepare for a meeting. The three listed unjustified conclusions (wrong-person chess claim, wrong OpenAlex affiliations, scope-inflated WHO decision authority) cannot be matched to any dossier claim or citation because the dossier contains no claims at all.
